prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, mid 40s goddess, legendary bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down jet-black hair — wearing a fine-linked silver chain mail micro halter bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups joined by a small metal ring at the center, thin fine-linked silver chain mail halter strings tied behind her neck, and a minimal low-rise fine-linked silver chain mail bottom of one tiny opaque triangle, its side strings made of strands of small white pearls tied at the hips with tiny knots, the small opaque pieces fully covering her, her stomach bare. Her right leg wears a pastel pink chunky ribbed knit leg warmer slouched in soft folds around her right calf from just above the ankle to just below the knee, her right knee, thigh and the top of her foot bare, the warmer resting above her heel. Her left leg wears a glossy deep-red latex thigh-high stocking with a thin elastic top band, stretched over her left thigh, knee, calf and ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the knee, completely opaque and running down into her heel. She wears a crown of fresh red roses and green leaves resting on her head. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme legendary bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of fine-linked silver chain mail, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each longer than her middle finger, in silver metallic lacquer with a high polish.
Body gems: a delicate line of small clear rhinestone crystals stuck directly on the bare skin along both collarbones, and a second ring of the same crystals around her navel, resting on the skin.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, heavy gold rings on every finger, and large drop earrings, a gold chain ending in a heavy black iron bell on one ear and a silver chain ending in a heavy gold pendant on the other, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.

Background: a bright empty ice rink with a clean white ice surface, a waist-high boards edge and standard-height gates, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
